messages.content:
Analyze the following resume text and extract structured information.
Return ONLY valid JSON with no markdown formatting.

Resume:
"""
Farhan Sheikh
Bengaluru | farhan.sec@example.com

PROFILE
Application security engineer who builds secure-by-default tooling for developers.

EXPERIENCE
Security Engineer, CRED (2022 - Present)
Rolled out SAST with Semgrep and dependency scanning with Snyk across 200 repositories.
Ran threat modelling sessions for the rewards platform using STRIDE.
Found and fixed an IDOR vulnerability that exposed other users' transaction history.
Built a secrets-detection pre-commit hook that blocked 1,400 leaked keys in its first year.

Security Analyst, Wipro (2019 - 2022)
Performed web application penetration tests with Burp Suite against OWASP Top 10.
Triaged SOC alerts in Splunk and wrote incident runbooks.

SKILLS
Python, Go, Burp Suite, Semgrep, Snyk, OWASP ZAP, AWS IAM, Vault, OAuth 2.0, JWT, threat modelling

CERTIFICATIONS
OSCP (Offensive Security Certified Professional)
AWS Certified Security Specialty

EDUCATION
B.Tech Computer Science, Manipal Institute of Technology, 2019

"""

Return this exact JSON structure:
{
  "skills": ["skill1", "skill2", ...],
  "experience_summary": "A 2-3 sentence summary of their work experience",
  "projects": ["Project 1: brief description", ...],
  "education": "Degree, University, Year"
}

Rules:
- skills: extract ALL technical and soft skills mentioned
- experience_summary: summarize roles, companies, and years of experience
- projects: list each project with a one-line description
- education: most recent degree with institution
- If a section is not found, use empty string or empty array
